name: Trade Promo Matching Agent
fn: Validates trade deductions against TPM promotions at SKU level
detail: Validates contract deductions against GPO/rebate programmes at system-model level, checking eligibility, dates and amount tolerance. Flags mismatches that would otherwise leak margin.
sap: SAP FSCM-DM · SD-TPM / Vistex programmes · FI-AR credit memo (FB75) · CO write-off postings
